_README: Stick shaping/zone config for pyESS_app.py (run pyess.bat).
'shaping' is SHARED by both output targets - that is what keeps SoH and
Dolphin/WiiVC producing the same in-game values. Per-target settings live
under 'targets'. Everything here is editable live in the GUI.
deadzone         square per-axis deadzone half-size; range is rescaled after it,
so ess_input_* are fractions of the POST-deadzone remainder.
ess_zone_size    how much stick past the deadzone holds ESS; the window

always STARTS at the deadzone edge and is compressed into the
                   derived ESS output band (see pyess_shaping.ess_output_band).
REFERENCE (decomp-verified): OoT applies its own square deadzone of 7 and clamps
raw cur at 67; magnitude <20 = ESS (pivot in place), >=20 walks. So in-game ESS is

soh._note: pyESS_n64geo.py -> Ship of Harkinian. libultraship MAX_AXIS_RANGE=85. input_lag_ms deliberately delays output 0..100ms (SoH only; a testing/handicap aid). Reference: the MEASURED WiiVC penalty over N64 is +33.8ms (95% CI 24.8-42.8, n=43, 240fps camera) = ~2 polls at 60Hz, so 33 is the value to use if you want SoH to match Dolphin-WiiVC.

dolphin._note: pyESS_dolphin_vc.py -> Dolphin running the OoT WiiVC WAD. gate_compensation stays 1.0 (no-op): RESOLVED - Dolphin's Gate Size was tested and causes no problem, so no compensation is needed. Kept only as an escape hatch if a future setup cannot pass values through 1:1.
